deployments_detail.use: "REiLI" medical imaging AI brand (since 2018), 1,000+ agents in operation; Alzheimer's progression prediction AI (MRI + deep learning)
deployments_detail.value: up to 88% accuracy predicting MCI-to-AD progression

deployments_detail.use: "FujifilmAIHub" agent-based generative AI platform rolling out to ~70,000 employees globally by FY2025

CAD EYE — real-time AI detection/characterization system for colonoscopy; deep-learning software integrated into ELUXEO endoscopy systems that flags suspected colorectal polyps (including flat lesions) live during exams. In clinical use in Japan/Europe since 2020, FDA-cleared and launched in the US in 2024. [Fujifilm (in-house deep learning)]

REiLI medical AI platform — vendor-neutral diagnostic-imaging AI platform integrated into Synapse PACS; in clinical use for automatic detection/prioritization of intracranial hemorrhage (Capital Health, NJ) and breast cancer/mammography (University Radiology Group across four NJ centers). [Fujifilm REiLI; partners MaxQ AI (Accipio), ScreenPoint Medical (Transpara)]

Synapse AI Orchestrator — open imaging workflow rules engine deployed in production that integrates 50+ validated third-party AI algorithms into Synapse Enterprise PACS, performing worklist triage, study prioritization, findings preview and critical-result notifications for radiology. [Fujifilm (vendor-agnostic orchestration)]

AI image-recognition inspection for semiconductor materials — AI-based image recognition introduced to inspect fine particles in semiconductor materials, improving analysis accuracy as part of an advanced quality-control system; deployed at the new Shizuoka Factory building that began operating in November 2025. [Fujifilm (in-house)]

NVIDIA DGX-2 AI supercomputer adoption — Fujifilm became the first company in Japan to adopt the NVIDIA DGX-2 (16 Tesla V100 GPUs w/ NVSwitch) to accelerate its deep-learning/AI R&D across healthcare, medical imaging and display/functional materials. [NVIDIA (DGX-2)]

'Predict-First' biomanufacturing AI — FUJIFILM Biotechnologies uses advanced machine learning/AI and bioinformatics to predict bioprocess production outcomes from culture conditions, de-risk biologic development and improve manufacturing predictability across its CDMO network. [FUJIFILM Biotechnologies (in-house ML/AI)]

AI-driven drug discovery — Fujifilm's CRO/drug-discovery services use AI simulation and analysis to generate/analyze compounds and explore drug mechanisms and gene targets, aiming to speed up and reduce the cost of creating new drug candidates. [Fujifilm (in-house AI)]

Fujifilm–AWS strategic collaboration — validates Synapse enterprise imaging (Radiology/Cardiology/Digital Pathology PACS, VNA) for AWS cloud hosting with the stated aim of improving data accessibility, security and AI utilization for clinical workflows; a first-of-its-kind North American Synapse Pathology deployment (5 sites, ~1.3M patients) followed. [Amazon Web Services]

Cash Application AI — custom machine-learning system built by FUJIFILM Business Innovation on Azure (Azure ML, VMs, Storage, integrated with Dynamics 365, RPA/Power Automate) to auto-match ~100,000 receipts and 1.2M invoices/month to invoices. In official operation since February 2022. [Microsoft Azure Machine Learning]
deployments_detail.value: ~20% of manual work automated (vs 10% target); over 70% accuracy in generating cash-application candidates

deployments_detail.use: AI-Powered Integrated Maintenance Support Platform — cloud platform for service/customer engineers featuring an AI Spare Parts Recommender and AI Service Manual to speed parts prep and on-site repair decisions for multifunction printers; global rollout began July 2026 (Japan, APAC, Europe, Americas) after trials in Hong Kong and Australia. [FUJIFILM Business Innovation (in-house)]
deployments_detail.value: none (trials showed improved parts-identification accuracy and reduced service work time)
